changes.body_writes: parts and manifests in one ordered write stream (100 rows per acknowledged transaction); a body with no stored part before the write is not read back after the acknowledgement (rows are inserted or byte-equal, a different representation raises AGENT_BODY_COLLISION in the statement); resumed bodies are still read back
changes.commit: fresh body rows (<=100) are inserted inside the commit transaction; no receipt re-read after an acknowledged commit, a replayed operation must carry the same receipt (checked in the statement, -20046); unknown outcome: one reconciliation read as before, never a resend; large or resumed bodies keep write-then-confirm before the commit
changes.file_writes: oracle_runtime_paths.write_file stores the file bytes with the head commit (one transaction)
changes.logs: oracle.sql.summary adds sql_sites (top 12 call sites: Agent method <- caller), sql_site_count, agent_ms, agent_calls (commit/body_write/body_read/lease_acquire/lease_release), request_cpu_ms; model.attempt.started/received carry sql_count_total, sql_ms_total, agent_ms_total, cpu_ms_total (per-segment split); no new per-SQL log line
changes.time_report_r2: reads the new fields (per-gap SQL/Agent/CPU/rest, call sites, Agent calls) and names known SQL hashes; older reports still print the R1 view
